title: Shiro Wat
description: Shiro Wat is a Ethiopia classic prepared with yellow onion, niter kibbeh, garlic, besan (gram flour). A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Toasted chickpea flour stands in for Ethiopian shiro flour blended with regional aromatics.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 14 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Whisk chickpea flour gradually with cool water to a smooth slurry, then cook it with the spiced onion base; stir frequently to avoid lumps.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 18 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
